title: Skill · print (output)
summary: The print output skill: a bill, receipt or packing slip painted on a chosen paper. READ-ONLY RECORD (identity standard section 9, Athi 12 Nov): it names what the code does today, it routes nothing. Three painters exist today, not one: bill-print.html render() (the settings preview and the print test), the till's printDoc (browser print window) and tools/tally-connector/printer.js (ESC/POS to a thermal printer). Variant ids below are the ids those files name.

skill.risk: A wrong slip prints a wrong tax word or total on paper a customer keeps; the print step must never block the sale (the till says so in a comment, tools/tally-connector/till.js, no written rule yet).

entries.s: the shop picks the paper and the head lines
entries.d: paper 80 | 58 | a4 held as the vault signature row 'paper'
paper 80 | 58 on the till's own printer setting

process.s: the one painter of the settings preview and the print test
process.d: show() calls render() only when the pack has tax words (CTRY-72)

exits.t: a slip on paper or in the preview frame
exits.s: nothing is sent to the server

relationships.that: tools/tally-connector/till.html set_paper and printer.js doc kinds (tests/skill-print.test.cjs)

tests.proves: the variant ids here, in cap-print.js, bill-print.html, the till page and printer.js are the same sets

changes.what: first read-only record of the print skill (identity standard section 9 census slice)
